literal: Good things all bad become, bad things even good become, wealth for making.
translation: In the pursuit of wealth, all good things may turn bad, and even bad things may turn good.
modern: செல்வத்தை ஈட்ட முயலும்போது, விதியின் காரணமாக நல்ல சூழ்நிலைகள் எல்லாம் தீயவையாக மாறிவிடும்; தீய சூழ்நிலைகளும் நல்லவையாக மாறி வெற்றியைத் தரும்.
explanation: This couplet illustrates the unpredictable power of fate in human endeavors, particularly in acquiring wealth. It states that when destiny is unfavorable, even the most favorable circumstances and good strategies will turn into failures. Conversely, when destiny is favorable, even adverse conditions and poor plans will transform into successes. The contrasting pairs of good and bad highlight how human calculation is ultimately subordinate to the natural order of fate.
